title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description:
You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a stock on day `i`.

You may complete **at most one** transaction: pick one day to buy and a **later** day to sell. Return the maximum profit you can make, or `0` if no profit is possible.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price 1) and sell on day 5 (price 6).
Prices only fall, so no transaction is worth making.

hints: For each day, the best buy is the cheapest price seen before it.
Track the running minimum and the best profit in a single pass.
